cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(Granulum VERSION 0.9.9)
# Name shown on the version plate in the plugin (may have an extra step like 0.99.1; the DAW version above stays 3 numbers)
set(GRAINFORM_LABEL "0.99.4")

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

if(MSVC)
    set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()

add_subdirectory(JUCE)

# Built-in OSC 3 noises (generated by tools/make_noises.py)
file(GLOB GRANULUM_NOISES ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Resources/noises/*.flac ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Resources/fonts/*.otf ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/Resources/samples/*.flac)
juce_add_binary_data(GranulumData HEADER_NAME BinaryData.h NAMESPACE BinaryData SOURCES ${GRANULUM_NOISES})
set_target_properties(GranulumData PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

juce_add_plugin(Granulum
    COMPANY_NAME "Thematic"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Thmt
    PLUGIN_CODE GrFm
    FORMATS VST3 AU Standalone
    AU_MAIN_TYPE kAudioUnitType_MusicDevice
    BUNDLE_ID com.grainform.grainform
    PRODUCT_NAME "GRAIN FORM"
    IS_SYNTH TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT TRUE
    NEEDS_MIDI_OUTPUT FALSE
    IS_MIDI_EFFECT FALSE
    EDITOR_WANTS_KEYBOARD_FOCUS FALSE
    VST3_CATEGORIES Instrument Sampler
    COPY_PLUGIN_AFTER_BUILD FALSE)

target_sources(Granulum PRIVATE
    Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
    Source/PluginEditor.cpp)

target_compile_definitions(Granulum PUBLIC
    GRAINFORM_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
    GRAINFORM_LABEL="${GRAINFORM_LABEL}"
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_VST3_CAN_REPLACE_VST2=0
    JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0)

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(Granulum PRIVATE /utf-8)
endif()

target_link_libraries(Granulum
    PRIVATE
        GranulumData
        juce::juce_audio_utils
        juce::juce_audio_formats
        juce::juce_dsp
    PUBLIC
        juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags)

# Offscreen renderer used by CI to preview the UI
juce_add_console_app(Snapshot PRODUCT_NAME "Snapshot")
target_sources(Snapshot PRIVATE
    tools/Snapshot.cpp
    Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
    Source/PluginEditor.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(Snapshot PRIVATE
    GRAINFORM_VERSION="${PROJECT_VERSION}"
    GRAINFORM_LABEL="${GRAINFORM_LABEL}"
    JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=0
    JUCE_USE_CURL=0
    JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED=1)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(Snapshot PRIVATE /utf-8)
endif()
target_link_libraries(Snapshot PRIVATE
    GranulumData
    juce::juce_audio_utils
    juce::juce_audio_formats
    juce::juce_dsp
    juce::juce_recommended_config_flags)
